description: This file contains a serializer class for handling Twilio Media Streams WebSocket protocol in a Pipecat project. It manages converting frames to Twilio WebSocket messages, handling media, DTMF events, and call termination via Twilio's REST API. It also includes configuration validation, audio data encoding/decoding, and integration with external utilities for audio processing.
